findings.description: Expired entries are never evicted; _cache only grows. Entries are overwritten only when the same key is requested again.
findings.scenario: cached(f'user:{uid}', loader) called for many distinct uid values over a long-running process: memory grows without bound even though every entry has expired.
findings.fix: Purge expired entries on write (e.g. drop keys whose timestamp is older than ttl) or cap the size of the cache.
